basic_info.description: Stunning Westwood Park craftsman home! This fully detached home on a generous lot features 5 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms plus a spacious family room. The lovely flat yard backs up to a green space for incredible privacy. Charming period details remain in tact, while fresh updates to the home provide modern convenience for today's lifestyle. The chef's kitchen features new countertops and all new stainless steel appliances. Walkable to Whole Foods Market and many great restaurants along Ocean Avenue. Close to public transit and easy access to the 101 for commuters. Come see why so many love to call Westwood Park home!
